LanguageData.CC_Settings_FaithTurretsHere: A faith against turrets minds only the turrets where they are
LanguageData.CC_Settings_FaithTurretsHere_Tip: With an ideology that scorns automated turrets or autonomous weapons: the game gives its mood to everyone while the colony owns such a turret anywhere, on another home or in a hatch's dungeon below the home whose turrets a hacked terminal handed over (the game keeps that dungeon's map once entered). With this on, the mood comes only to the colony's people on a map where the colony has an automated turret, or one of its mechanoids, which the game counts too. A turret someone has to man, such as a mortar, doesn't count. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_FaithTurretsHere: A faith against turrets minds only the map where the turrets stand.
